source.title: Cube was found to have textured center for multiblind attempt at the end of competition
source.content: After the competition had ended, delegates noticed that one of the cubes used by a competitor in Multiblind had a centerpiece that was texturally affected. The delegates noted that it was possible to distinguish the center from other centers by touch. The decision was to count the puzzle as unsolved for the attempts per [3k2b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3k2b). That is, the number of solved puzzles for the two attempts both decreased by 1. Even though we cannot confirm whether or not the cube was actually solved at the end of the attempt, submitting a legal cube is the responsibility of the competitor and it would be unfair to count the puzzle as solved. Additionally, it is more likely that the cube was solved than unsolved.

translation.title: 赛末发现多盲魔方中心块触感可辨
translation.content:
比赛结束后，代表发现一名选手用于多盲的某个魔方中心块触感有异，可以通过触摸与其他中心块区分。依据 [3k2b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3k2b)，决定在相关尝试中将该魔方计为未还原，即两次尝试的成功数均减 1。

虽然无法确认该魔方在尝试结束时实际是否已还原，但提交合规魔方是选手责任，将其计为成功并不公平。此外，该魔方已还原的可能性也高于未还原。
